title: CGIAR++ PhD Scholarship 2026: Call for Applications for 10 PhD Candidates at German Universities
summary: The CGIAR++ PhD Scholarship 2026 is now accepting applications from qualified candidates interested in pursuing doctoral research in agricultural sciences and related interdisciplinary fields at a German university. The scholarship provides an opportunity for researchers with an MSc degree to develop a PhD project connected to ongoing CGIAR++ research activities and to work under joint supervision from a senior CGIAR++ scientist and a professor affiliated with a German university. For the 2026 call, the Hub plans to support 10 PhD candidates . The previous call in 2025 attracted a high volume of qualified applications and had an acceptance rate of just 5% , highlighting the competitive nature of the opportunity. The application deadline for the current call is 30 November 2026 . CGIAR++ PhD Scholarship 2026 Overview The programme is designed for candidates who want to undertake doctoral research that contributes to existing CGIAR++ research activities. A particularly important feature of the scholarship is its collaborative structure: applicants cannot apply independently without first establishing the required academic and research partnerships. Each accepted candidate must form a “tridem” consisting of: The PhD candidate. A senior CGIAR++ scientist. A professor affiliated with a German university. These three parties are expected to work together to develop the scientific proposal and establish the supervision and research arrangements required for the PhD. The PhD project must also be connected to an ongoing CGIAR++ research activity and should provide additional value to that research programme. Deadline for the CGIAR++ PhD Scholarship 2026 Application deadline: 30 November 2026 Applicants should begin preparing their applications well before the deadline because the process requires coordination with both a CGIAR++ senior scientist and a professor affiliated with a German university. The required supervisory and hosting documents must also be prepared and submitted according to the application instructions. Who Can Apply for the CGIAR++ PhD Scholarship? The call is aimed at candidates who already hold an MSc degree in Agricultural Sciences or a related discipline and who meet the academic requirements specified by the programme. Relevant academic backgrounds can include a broad range of disciplines, reflecting the interdisciplinary nature of the research supported by the programme. Examples specifically listed in the call include: Agricultural Sciences Biology Geography Sociology Veterinary Medicine Marine Biology Forestry Political Sciences Law Economics Other related fields Applicants are expected to have achieved an above-average final grade in their MSc degree. Requirements for Non-European Degrees Candidates holding degrees from outside Europe must additionally provide a ranking from the issuing university . This requirement allows the programme to assess the academic standing of qualifications obtained outside the European university system. A Unique Three-Way Research and Supervision Structure One of the most important requirements of the scholarship is that applicants must establish the appropriate research partnership before submitting their application. Only applications from the required “tridems” will be accepted. The tridem consists of: 1. The PhD Candidate The candidate develops and undertakes the proposed doctoral research and must meet the academic requirements of the programme. 2. CGIAR++ Senior Scientist The candidate must work with a senior scientist from a CGIAR++ Center. The scientist serves as the CGIAR++ supervisor and must confirm the candidate s connection to an appropriate CGIAR++ research programme or project. 3. Professor at a German University The candidate must also identify a professor affiliated with a German university who will jointly supervise the doctoral project. The scientific proposal is developed collaboratively by these three parties. This means prospective applicants should not wait until the final stages of the application process to identify their supervisors. Establishing the required research relationships is an essential part of becoming eligible to apply. PhD Research Must Be Connected to CGIAR++ Research Another central requirement is that candidates must be hosted by a CGIAR++ Center . The proposed doctoral research must be attached to an ongoing CGIAR++ research activity . The call indicates that the project is preferably connected to an international, multidisciplinary research project . The proposed PhD research should not simply duplicate existing research. Instead, it should be: Connected to an ongoing CGIAR++ research activity. Complementary to the existing research. Designed to provide additional value to the CGIAR++ research activity. Supported by an appropriate CGIAR++ Center. Developed with the CGIAR++ and German university supervisors. This makes the scholarship particularly relevant to candidates who can demonstrate how their proposed doctoral research fits into a broader research programme. PhD Study at a German University Successful candidates must enroll in a PhD study programme at a German university . However, applicants do not need to be German nationals . The programme therefore provides an opportunity for qualified international candidates to pursue doctoral studies in Germany while maintaining a research connection with a CGIAR++ Center. Applicants from CGIAR++ partner countries are welcome to apply . The call also specifically states that female students are particularly encouraged to apply . Documents Required from Applicants Candidates must prepare several documents as part of their application. 1. Letter of Motivation Applicants must provide a signed letter of motivation . The letter must be: Signed by the applicant. No more than one page. The motivation letter should be prepared carefully because it forms part of the candidate s application package. 2. Curriculum Vitae Applicants must submit a tabular CV . The CV must be: No more than one page. Signed. Dated. Presented in tabular form. Candidates should therefore ensure that their CV follows the format requested by the programme rather than submitting an unnecessarily long academic CV. 3. Research Proposal A research proposal is required. Applicants must use the official research proposal template provided by the programme. Research Proposal Template The proposal should be developed jointly with the required supervisors because the scholarship specifically requires a scientific proposal created through the tridem structure. 4. MSc Certificate and Academic Transcript Applicants must submit: Their MSc certificate. Their transcript of academic records. These documents must be issued by the examination office . Applicants with non-European degrees should also remember the additional requirement concerning university ranking. 5. English Proficiency Certificate Applicants must provide evidence of English-language proficiency. The call accepts: TOEFL IELTS Another English proficiency certificate Candidates should make sure that their proof of English proficiency satisfies the programme s requirements. Documents Required From the Supervisors The application also requires documents from the two supervisory sides of the proposed PhD. These documents must be sent by the respective supervisors as one PDF by email to: hub@landscapealliance.org The supervisor documentation includes three important components. 1. German University Professor s Recommendation and Supervision Confirmation The professor affiliated with a German university must provide: A letter of recommendation. Confirmation of supervision. The programme provides a specific template that should be used. German University Supervisor Template 2. CGIAR++ Scientist Recommendation and Supervision Commitment The CGIAR++ Center scientist must provide: A letter of recommendation. A supervision commitment. Confirmation that the candidate is attached to a relevant CGIAR++ research programme or project. The programme also provides a specific template for this document. CGIAR++ Supervisor Template 3. Hosting Agreement The respective CGIAR++ Center must also provide a Hosting Agreement . This confirms the candidate s intended hosting arrangement with the CGIAR++ Center. The official template is available here: CGIAR++ Hosting Agreement Template All three supervisor-related documents are to be sent together as one PDF to hub@landscapealliance.org . 10 PhD Candidates to Be Supported For the current 2026 call, the Hub is seeking to support 10 PhD candidates .
